test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is '**Delightfull**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is '**Delightfull**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Delightful**'.
 
• It means **'causing delight; charming'. **(खुशी का कारण; आकर्षक)
 
 
• *Example: It was going to be **delightful** cooking in this kitchen.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Delete**: to remove something that is written. (लिखित अंश को हटाना)
 
• **Delicate**: easy to damage or break. (नाज़ुक, आसानी से टूट जाने वाला)
 
• **Delicious**: having a very pleasant taste or smell. (स्‍वादिष्‍ट या सुगंधित)
